quote.text: every man is worth   just so much as the things are worth about which he busies himself.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that the values and interests you nurture in your children profoundly shape who they become—invest their time and energy in teaching them virtues that hold real worth.
    • Reflect on how your actions model what truly matters; just as a man’s worth is tied to his pursuits, a parent's daily choices set the stage for a meaningful, honorable life for their children.
  • Leadership
    • Understand that a leader's influence is measured by the quality of decisions and actions they commit to; your focus on integrity and purpose can uplift an entire team.
    • Invest in activities and values that serve the greater good, acknowledging that the substance of your endeavors not only defines your worth but also inspires others to emulate that commitment.
  • Product Management
    • Realize that prioritizing what truly matters—such as customer value, ethical innovation, and efficient execution—reinforces both your personal worth and the product's impact.
    • Align your daily tasks with core values and strategic goals; by doing so, you ensure that each decision increases the intrinsic worth of your work and contributes meaningfully to the product's success.
